uid.description: The unique identifier for the user.

createdAt.description: The time the user profile was created.

role.description: The user's role in the application.

streak.description: The current consecutive days of study.

lastActivity.description: The last time the user completed a quiz.

totalCorrectAnswers.description: Total correct answers across all quizzes.

backgroundUrl.description: The URL or base64 string of the user's background image.

backgroundBlur.description: The blur level for the background image.

backgroundOpacity.description: The opacity level for the background image.

customBackgrounds.description: List of custom background objects {id, name, url}.

customThemeColor.description: The hex code for the custom theme color.

subjects.description: List of study subjects managed by the user.

SRSItem.title: SRS Item
SRSItem.description: Stores a question for spaced repetition review.

uid.description: The UID of the user who owns this item.

interval.description: The interval in days until the next review.

nextReviewDate.description: The date and time for the next review.

QuizResult.title: Quiz Result
QuizResult.description: Stores the outcome of a completed quiz.

uid.description: The UID of the user who took the quiz.

date.description: The date and time the quiz was completed.

total.description: The total number of questions in the quiz.

timeSpent.description: The total time spent on the quiz in seconds.

fileName.description: The name of the file or source used for the quiz.

questions.description: The list of questions generated for the quiz.

answers.description: The user's answers for each question.

content.description: The source content used to generate the quiz.

Flashcard.title: Flashcard
Flashcard.description: A study flashcard with a front and back side.

uid.description: The user ID who owns this flashcard.

front.description: The question or concept on the front.

back.description: The answer or explanation on the back.

MindMap.title: MindMap
MindMap.description: An AI-generated mind map in Mermaid.js format.

uid.description: The user ID who owns this mind map.

mermaidCode.description: The Mermaid.js code for the diagram.

subject.description: The subject of the mind map.

SRSRegistry.title: SRS Registry
SRSRegistry.description: Consolidated spaced repetition items for a user to reduce write operations.

uid.description: The UID of the user who owns this registry.

items.description: Map of SRS items where keys are item IDs.
